record.title: Evaluate labeling evidence and select the next bounded transition
record.intent: Decide whether to stop at a terminal condition or admit one evidence-backed environment investigation.
requirements: Stop at a stable useful UI or a genuine hardware dependency requiring behavioral modeling.
Do not infer application progress from installation, a starting window, or a PID alone.
Reconcile material architecture changes; preserve experiment failures and uncertainty.
acceptance: Classify the observed boundary with durable evidence and state what has and has not executed.
Record a terminal report or draft a small successor batch for one clear continuation within standing authorization.
Do not publish externally or alter official artifacts, host security, or physical instruments.
